config.ad_backend: AutoEnzyme(Reverse, runtime_activity, Const), used by BRM.adaptive_centering_problem
config.controls: generated bare non-centered and centered models carry no reparametrizer, so their nonlinear_adapt flag pairs must be identical
config.inventory_contract: model bodies are read from translations.tsv and cross-checked against model_matrix.tsv; real-data adapters are consumer-side
config.run_order: one untimed preflight per arm/flag; recorded flag order alternates by seed to avoid systematic temporal bias

models.current_brm_body:
loc ~ 1 + (1 | Batch)
log(sigma) ~ 1
Yield ~ Normal(loc, sigma)
models.data_adapter: Yield copied as Float64; Batch deterministically recoded to dense integers

models.current_brm_body:
loc ~ Days + (Days | Subject)
log(sigma) ~ 1
Reaction ~ Normal(loc, sigma)
models.data_adapter: Reaction and Days copied as Float64 without response scaling; Subject deterministically recoded to dense integers

models.current_brm_body:
loc ~ Time + (Time|Pig)
log(sigma) ~ 1
Weight ~ Normal(loc, sigma)
models.data_adapter: Weight and Time copied as Float64; Pig deterministically recoded to dense integers
